method.summary: World models for robotic manipulation predict future states to support planning or condition policies on anticipated scene and physical evolution [ 31 , 16 , 11 , 24 ] . Recent works mainly focus on visual or video prediction, generating future RGB frames or latent visual features for manipulation and action generation [ 16 , 40 , 39 , 18 ] . These models are also used as learned simulators or policy-conditioning modules, reflecting a shift from reactive perception to predictive control [ 22 , 28 ] .
